messages:
leah_partnerships: Quick heads-up: ModelRiver proposed listing on Redwood Marketplace. They asked for redistribution rights, permission for quantized/optimized builds, and a co-branded blog. Sharing the draft they sent.

sam_legal: skimmed. Concern: "no-derivatives" language could block our optimization work. Need explicit sublicensing + warranty on training data and export control clause.

ankit_pm: they mentioned both "research-only" and "commercial licensing available" in different slides. Which one is authoritative? we should ask for the license file.

dylan_engineer: if derivative bans exist, we can't ship INT8/4-bit quantized variants or sharded checkpoints for Dedicated. Need technical addendum listing allowed transforms: quantize, shard, convert to runtime format, and create fused kernels.

leah_partnerships: @dylan_engineer please draft that addendum; @sam_legal please prepare a proposed license paragraph we can send.

sam_legal: proposed grant to send:
```
Grant: Provider grants Redwood a non-exclusive, worldwide, sublicensable license to host, distribute, and sublicense Provider's model artifacts via Redwood's marketplace and hosted services for the Term; Redwood may produce and distribute optimized or quantized variants for inference.
```

ModelRiver Rep: "We're open to commercial hosting. We'd like 15% revenue share if Redwood handles billing, plus approval on co-branded copy. We'll deliver a cleaner license.txt and provenance by EOD tomorrow."

ankit_pm: 15% could work if we set a pricing floor. Suggest tiered rev-share: 8% until $25k/mo, 12% until $100k/mo, 15% above. I'll run numbers.

olivia_ops: ops needs: signed provenance metadata, checksums, SBOM, and delivery artifacts (container or S3 bundle). We need 72h after receipt to provision the listing.

dylan_engineer: also confirm they allow us to log model outputs for safety monitoring and to use sample checkpoints for perf testing.

sam_legal: agenda for call: sublicensing, rev-share schedule, marketing approval turn-around (48h), export controls, takedown process, warranties about training data third-party rights, termination for IP breach.

leah_partnerships: scheduling call Wed 11am PT. uploading draft redlines to GH and creating onboarding checklist. I'll post updates here after the call. :thumbsup:

partnerbot: Reminder: partnership intake still missing distribution_terms field: https://redwood.internal/partnerships/intake

olivia_ops: filled intake and preregistered onboarding bucket. will share runbook after license confirmed.

sam_legal: posted two redlines in GH: export-control & 30-day cure period. also asked for upstream licenses for datasets.

leah_partnerships: thanks all. next steps: 1) get license.txt from ModelRiver, 2) legal redlines, 3) pricing/rev-share proposal, 4) ops artifact checklist. Will update.
